signal_evidence.capex_direction: For FY27, we're guiding CapEx of approximately $25 billion to $30 billion... covering delivery of contracted Microsoft capacity, air-cooled 2027 builds and a large portion of 2H-2027 liquid-cooled work.
signal_evidence.pricing_power: 3-year contract pricing is up about 125% since November... recent 3-year contracts are pricing in excess of $20 million per megawatt of IT load... active discussions are now at around $25 million per megawatt.
signal_evidence.management_tone_shift: GPU financing barely existed as an asset class 12 months ago, and in the last 3 months we've raised $6.5 billion of it at both ends of the credit spectrum. That's not us getting lucky with financing, that's a market forming.
